notes.title: New year resolutions
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32571749/2ad3cbe65f45726289f8065b0cec2b89e54ef905.png[/img]

[h1]Hello everyone! [/h1]
We hope you’ve had good Christmas holidays and are ready to bid farewell to 2020. Well, I mean… who isn’t?

This is a perfect moment to share with you what we’ve been up to these couple of weeks. That’s because – aside from the “new year, new me” shenanigans – we’ve finished gathering and analyzing all the feedback you’ve given us on IAYP: Prologue. And we’re ready to make some bold design decisions!

First and foremost:[b] we’re incredibly thankful to everybody who played our game![/b] Double points if you cared enough to share your experiences with us – both negative and positive. And while it feels great to receive praise, we’ve still got a game to finish, so we cannot afford to overlook the common criticisms, i.e. stability & optimization issues, confusing gameplay and railroading. 

Although the main game is going to immensely improve on all of those, your feedback has highlighted your expectations of IAYP. We’d really like to make IAYP unforgettable for you – not just in a singular choose-your-own-adventure type of way, but also in a more randomized and uncontrolled setting. We want our game to be a bit bolder and more unhinged than other political simulators, without dropping the charade all the way – after all, as this past decade has shown us, politics really is all about appearances!

[list]
[*][b]We’re going to make IAYP more dynamic and roguelite-ish, by, for example:[/b]
[olist]
[*]Making each playthrough denser. Less waiting, more choices!
[*]Getting rid of $ altogether and instead using the economy stat as currency
[*]Introducing some small persistent progression systems (e.g. project/tech trees start of hidden, but once researched, remain uncovered in subsequent playthroughs)
[*]Including some form of point/evaluation system at the end of each playthrough
[*]much, much more…
[/olist]
[*][b]We’re going to put more emphasis on protagonist’s political self-identification, introducing a new feature – political compass, complete with 19 political affiliations that will affect the type of legislation that the president signs on a near-daily basis![/b]
[*][b]We’re going to focus on two distinct gameplay pillars:[/b]
[olist]
[*]Largely randomized dialogues and events: the meat of the story and the spice of life!
[*]Robust secondary features to give the players (including those looking for a more serious experience) numerous opportunities for min-maxing and strategizing. This means that we’ll be interlinking all features closely and giving them enough depth to turn e.g. the map or project management into an optional mini-game
[/olist]
[*][b]We’re expanding the importance of Action Points – no need to worry about all these features right away, given the limitations![/b]
[/list]

Okay, that’s enough for now, before I get too excited… Of course, it’s not all good news: as some of you might have already been suspecting, this means that we still have some things to do, pushing back the publishing of the product a few extra months. Realistically – I do not think this could have been avoided, especially in light of the optimization issues present in the prologue. We hate to do it to you again, but we have to get our cyber playground in order, else everyone could just end up getting punked.

And meanwhile, why don’t you share your thoughts in #president-chat? Are we moving in the right direction? Or am I just rambling like a madman? Are those mutually exclusive?

Thank you for your continuous trust and support! We’ll do our best to not betray your expectations & keep you up to date with our affairs! Tons of love from the team, [b]we wish you all best of luck in 2021[/b]!

notes.title: I Am Your President: Prologue - Patch #2
notes.content:
[h1]Hi everyone! [/h1]

We continue to implement your ideas into the game. For now, we want to release a small patch that should[b] improve loading times on HDD[/b] drives. We're adding a few other things as well, hopefully it will improve your prologue experience;).

[list]
[*] Game Settings: [b]Run In Background switch added[/b]. While loading, the app has Run In Background active on default, so it's still loading when minimized. You can change this option whenever you want.
[*] [b]Better loading times[/b] - we've found out what caused the game to load so slowly and we've fixed it. Our work is not yet done here, but the improvements are big. In the nearest future the loading times will get even quicker.
[*]Items description now shown in each turn - this is our experimental feature, to deepen the immersion. Tell us what you think about it. 
[*]Fixed some bugs
[*]Probably added more bugs than before
[/list]

We are in touch. Remember that you can write to us on Discord. We also read all your opinions sent via the form available in the game :). Your opinion is very important to us. It helps us improve our game. 

Cheers!

notes.title: A patch to I Am Your President: Prologue is now available!
notes.content:
[h1]A patch to I Am Your President: Prologue is now available![/h1]

[h3]Here’s what we have improved: [/h3]
[list]
[*] Language & typo corrections 
[*] Numerous optimization tweaks 
[*] Fixed incorrect stat change prompts in some of the dialogue choices 
[*] Improved plot flags 
[*] Added credits! The last one is pretty important, as we’ve included the nicknames of our Discord supporters – yes,[b] you[/b]! You’ve really fueled our creative flames and given us some great ideas, some of which you’ll be able to see in the main game.
[/list]
 
[h3]Oh, and one more thing![/h3]
Huge thank you for those of you that took a moment to share their feedback on our game on Steam. We cannot overstate how helpful that is to us! Talk to you soon & sit tight while we’re uploading the patch! And remember what your devs say: do not click on the loading screen while the game is loading, cause Windows might incorrectly interpret it as a freeze (picture related)! We're working on fixing the issue ASAP - thank you for your patience!

notes.title: I Am Your President: Prologue - Release
notes.content:
[h1]The time has come everyone![/h1]

We are proud to announce that [b]I Am Your President: Prologue is finally out![/b] Moreover, [b]it is – now and forever – free to play![/b]

You can find it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1201330/

Experience the events leading up to the presidency of Your President – from the perspective of his predecessor! Try to finish this self-contained story to get a taste of what it means to occupy the oval office and know whose shoes you will be filling in the main game. Just keep in mind the fact that being the leader of the free world is no easy task and the outcome of this grand balancing act will be – in the best case scenario – bittersweet.

The prologue is also a great way to familiarize yourself with the core game mechanics and features, most of which are included, albeit in a much more straightforward form. Sign legislation, post on social media, tackle international crises as they unfold, survive the barrage of questions at a press conference and much, much more… Overall, completing the prologue should take you approximately 40 minutes, though that can vary depending on the path you choose. And if you are a completionist – there’s a bunch of Steam achievements for you to unlock!

A huge “thank you” goes out to everyone that has been supporting IAYP project and – as always – if you have any questions or feedback to us, feel free to drop us a message on our Discord – we read all of them and continuously improve based on your input!

Talk to you soon!
~IAYP team
